answer: Re-attestations are stored in sonnet and onyx lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the umber graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1733 impostors cost 272 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
